decision: For a new pure scalar program, read LANGUAGE.md for syntax and edit your own ordinary typed source. The sample is a pattern, not your answer. Compile, inspect imports and execute the requested calls with scripts/wasmc-agent-execute.mjs. This runner refuses any Host imports before instantiation; effectful or managed programs need their separately approved profile.
host_boundary: A declared import requests an effect; application authorization and a bounded adapter are separately required.
runner_rule: The runner interface is complete above. Run once for the requested source/calls; report exact results and stop. No repository-wide integrity test or source inspection is needed after the named runner check.
digest_rejection_probe: node scripts/wasmc-agent-probe.mjs --source PATH --export NAME --calls JSON --expected-compiler-sha256 SHA256
digest_rejection_rule: For an independently expected wrong digest, use the probe to capture the actual verifier subprocess nonzero exit, error and actual/expected digests as a successful expected-negative observation. It asserts the exact digest rejection before compilation or instantiation. This does not approve execution. A manifest rewrite cannot replace the independently supplied expectation. After this named probe returns, report its actual evidence and stop; do not run extra whole-product integrity tests or a positive control.
final_answer_policy: Report requested source and Core evidence exactly. Copy a requested SHA256 in full once, or reference verified field names when no digest value was requested. Never shorten a digest, even when discussing a negative example.
